warnings: Half (hip-end) truss: from the D end the top chord slopes up for the first 2.00 (1.00 + 1.00), then runs flat at 1.15 to the T2 end (the elevation labels that end 'T2'). The flat top is the wing ridge ระดับหลังอกไก่ +5.24 (4.09 + 1.15).

Four section callouts: sloped top chord 2C-100x50x20x3.2, flat top chord 2C-150x50x20x3.2, verticals and diagonals C-100x50x20x3.2 (one callout, two leaders), bottom chord อะเส 2C-150x50x20x3.2 — kept per member in truss_members (no single steel_section).

Panel chain 1.00 + 1.00 + 0.92 x 3 adds to 4.76 against the printed 4.75 (rounding). It is printed with no grid markers (floating chain in the grid master); read against S-03/S-04 the truss lies on 1'' from D to A'''.
